pairs: I will be the God of all the families of Israel,
et ipsi erunt mihi in populum.
and they will be my people.”
Invenit gratiam in deserto populus qui remanserat a gladio:
“The people who had remained after the sword, found grace in the desert.
Israel will go to his rest.”
The Lord appeared to me from a distance:
Et in caritate perpetua dilexi te:
“And I have loved you in perpetual charity.
And I will build you up again.
And you shall be built up,
Still shall you be adorned with your timbrels,
and still shall you go forth to the singing of those who play.
Adhuc plantabis vineas in montibus Samariæ:
Still shall you plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria.
et donec tempus veniat, non vindemiabunt.
and they will not gather the vintage until the time arrives.
Quia erit dies in qua clamabunt custodes in monte Ephraim:
For there will be a day on which the guardians on mount Ephraim will cry out:
et ascendamus in Sion ad Dominum Deum nostrum.
And let us ascend on Zion to the Lord our God!’”
et hinnite contra caput gentium: personate,
and neigh before the head of the Gentiles. Shout,
Ecce ego adducam eos de terra aquilonis,
et congregabo eos ab extremis terræ:
I will lead them from the land of the north,
and I will gather them from the ends of the earth.
Among them will be the blind and the lame,
together with she who is giving birth:
a great assembly returning to this place.
And I will lead them back with mercy.
et adducam eos per torrentes aquarum in via recta,
And I will lead them through the torrents of water, by an upright way,
and they will not stumble in it.
For I have become Father to Israel,
Listen to the word of the Lord,
et annuntiate in insulis quæ procul sunt,
and announce it amid the islands that are far away,
“Whoever has scattered Israel will gather him,
et custodiet eum sicut pastor gregem suum.
and he will guard him as a shepherd guards his flock.”
For the Lord has redeemed Jacob,
et liberavit eum de manu potentioris.
and he has freed him from the hand of one more powerful.
And they will arrive and give praise on Mount Zion.
to the good things of the Lord,
and the offspring of cattle and herds.
eritque anima eorum quasi hortus irriguus,
And their soul will be like an irrigated garden,
and they will no longer be hungry.
Then the virgin will rejoice with singing,
the young and the old together,
et convertam luctum eorum in gaudium,
and I will turn their mourning into gladness,
et consolabor eos, et lætificabo a dolore suo.
and I will console them and gladden them after their sorrow.
And I will inebriate the soul of the priests with fatness,
et populus meus bonis meis adimplebitur,
and my people will be filled with my good things,
Vox in excelso audita est lamentationis:
“A voice has been heard on high: of lamentation,
et fletus Rachel plorantis filios suos, et nolentis consolari super eis,
and weeping; of Rachel crying for her sons and refusing to be consoled over them,
For there is a reward for your work,
And they will return from the land of the enemy.
And there is hope for your very end,
et revertentur filii ad terminos suos.
And the sons will return to their own borders.
Listening, I heard Ephraim going into captivity:
like a young untamed bull. Convert me,
For you are the Lord my God.
And after you revealed to me,
For I have endured the disgrace of my youth.’
Certainly, Ephraim is an honorable son to me;
surely, he is a tender child.
quia ex quo locutus sum de eo,
For I will still remember him,
adhuc recordabor ejus. Idcirco conturbata sunt viscera mea super eum:
as in the time when I first spoke about him. Because my heart is stirred up over him,
surely I will take pity on him,
dirige cor tuum in viam rectam in qua ambulasti: revertere,
Direct your heart into the upright way, in which you used to walk.
O virgin of Israel, to these your cities!
How long will you be absorbed in delights,
quia creavit Dominus novum super terram:
For the Lord has created something new upon the earth:
a woman will encompass a man.”
Thus says the Lord of hosts,
Adhuc dicent verbum istud in terra Juda
“Still they will speak this word in the land of Judah,
when I will convert their captivity:
et habitabunt in eo Judas et omnes civitates ejus simul,
And they will live in it: Judah together with all its cities,
the farmer and those who drive the flocks.
For I have inebriated the weary soul,
and I have satisfied every hungry soul.
Ideo quasi de somno suscitatus sum:
Over this, I was awakened, as if from a deep sleep.
and my sleep became sweet to me.
dicit Dominus, et seminabo domum Israël et domum Juda semine hominum et semine jumentorum.
says the Lord, when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the offspring of men and with the offspring of cattle.
Et sicut vigilavi super eos ut evellerem, et demolirer,
And just as I have watched over them, so that I may root up,
sic vigilabo super eos ut ædificem et plantem,
so will I watch over them, so that I may build and plant them,
In diebus illis non dicent ultra:
In those days, they will no longer say:
and the teeth of the sons have been affected.’
Sed unusquisque in iniquitate sua morietur:
Instead, each one will die for his own iniquity.
omnis homo qui comederit uvam acerbam,
Each man who will have eaten a bitter grape,
his own teeth will be affected.
when I will form a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
non secundum pactum quod pepigi cum patribus eorum in die qua apprehendi manum eorum ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti,
not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers, in the day when I took them by the hand, so as to lead them away from the land of Egypt,
though I was the ruler over them,
Sed hoc erit pactum quod feriam cum domo Israël post dies illos,
But this will be the covenant that I will form with the house of Israel, after those days,
dabo legem meam in visceribus eorum,
I will give my law to their inner most being,
et in corde eorum scribam eam,
and I will write it upon their heart.
And I will be their God,
et ipsi erunt mihi in populum:
and they shall be my people.
et non docebit ultra vir proximum suum et vir fratrem suum,
And they will no longer teach, a man his neighbor, and a man his brother,
omnes enim cognoscent me, a minimo eorum usque ad maximum,
For all will know me, from the littlest of them even to the greatest,
For I will forgive their iniquity,
et peccati eorum non memorabor amplius.
and I will no longer remember their sin.
Hæc dicit Dominus qui dat solem in lumine diei,
ordinem lunæ et stellarum in lumine noctis:
who gives the sun as the light of the day,
who puts the moon and the stars in order as the light of the night,
who stirs up the sea and makes its waves roar:
the Lord of hosts is his name.
Si defecerint leges istæ coram me,
If these laws fail in my sight,
then the offspring of Israel will also fail,
ut non sit gens coram me cunctis diebus.
so that they will not be a people in my sight for all time.”
“If the heavens above are able to be measured,
and if the foundations of the earth beneath can be examined,
et ego abjiciam universum semen Israël,
I also will cast aside all the offspring of Israel,
because of all that they have done,
et ædificabitur civitas Domino, a turre Hananeel usque ad portam anguli.
when a city will be built for the Lord from the tower of Hananel, even to the Gate of the Corner;
Et exibit ultra norma mensuræ in conspectu ejus super collem Gareb,
and the measuring line will go on even further in his sight, over the hill of Gareb,
et omnem vallem cadaverum, et cineris,
and the entire Valley of dead bodies and ashes,
et universam regionem mortis usque ad torrentem Cedron,
and the entire region of death, even to the torrent of Kedron,
et usque ad angulum portæ equorum orientalis, Sanctum Domini:
and to the corner of the Horse Gate to the east. All this will be the holy place of the Lord.
It will not be rooted up,
et non destruetur ultra in perpetuum.
and it will not be torn down, anymore, forever.”
